<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially, then mirror the opponent’s most recent action. This preserves mutual cooperation with cooperative opponents while immediately responding to defection, avoiding the extra exploitable round allowed by the current two-defection threshold.
</DESCRIPTION>
